definition: πραιτώριον, -ου, τό (Lat. prætorium)  __1. headquarters in a Roman camp,  __2. The palace or official residence of the Governor of a province: Mat.27:27, Mrk.15:16 (see Swete, in l), Jhn.18:28, 33 19:9; τ. π. τ. Ἡρώδου, Act.23:35.  __3. the Prætorian Guard: Php.1:13 (see Lft., in l; ICC, 51 f.).† (AS)
